profile.name: Jonathan Witherspoon
profile.intro: I build and run infrastructure, and I automate the repetitive parts of it. I am the person who gets the call when things break and the one who makes sure they break less often.
about: I grew up dying of dysentery and guessing how to play Minesweeper, and I learned to install Windows 95 before I left elementary school.

Since then I have been boots on the ground implementing infrastructure, the person who gets the call at midnight, and the person behind the scenes streamlining workflows. Learning PowerShell is when IT became fun for me, because it showed me what solving problems through automation looks like.

I am not chasing a title. I want to build things that matter, keep learning how technologies fit together, and do work where owning the implementation is part of the job. I also like helping people understand the tools they use.

experience.title: Support Engineer
bullets: Senior escalation point on a 300+ ticket/week multi-market service desk covering 100+ clients and 10,000+ managed endpoints. Maintained 80–90% billable utilization across the full three-year tenure, personally resolving ~25 tickets daily with a <10% reopen rate.

Engineered enterprise BitLocker automation for Dell devices and automated M365 tenant onboarding via Azure Function App and PowerShell, reducing configuration errors by 75% and eliminating manual technician steps across the endpoint fleet.
Developed ConnectWise Automate scripts for Microsoft Teams installation and removal on macOS and Windows, reducing per-incident handling time across a 20-person engineering team.

Built the team's Hudu knowledge base from scratch (40+ articles covering common and complex issues, internal processes, and escalation guides) and mentored 5+ junior engineers, reducing escalation volume by 25%.

experience.title: Solutions Engineer
bullets: Delivered tier-3 engineering support across 80+ clients in veterinary, law enforcement, medical, and education sectors. Designed and implemented security and deployment processes adopted organization-wide.

Pioneered ChromeOS patch management for Georgia Cyber Academy's 5,000+ device fleet using a staggered test-group rollout methodology, ensuring zero-downtime updates and establishing a repeatable deployment process adopted across the client base.
Designed and implemented a ChromeOS extension vetting process (security review, isolated behavioral testing, staged deployment) applied across 80+ clients.

Configured Conditional Access policies (MFA enforcement, geo-blocking) and automated new user onboarding using dynamic distribution groups and group-based licensing across multi-tenant Microsoft 365 environments.
Delivered tier-3 escalation support for Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, and Windows Server, including installation and configuration of server roles (AD DS, DHCP, DNS, ADUC) across client environments.

experience.title: IT Technician
bullets: Sole IT technician responsible for endpoint management, infrastructure, and network security across a ~200-device mixed-OS production environment.
Pioneered WDS server deployment and built a fully unattended Windows 10 migration using answer files, replacing manual USB installs with a boot-to-network, zero-touch process across ~200 endpoints.
Implemented WSUS for patch management using a staggered test-group rollout, maintaining update compliance across mixed Windows, Linux, iOS, and Android devices.

Deployed FreeRADIUS on Ubuntu Server to enforce wireless network authentication across the entire production facility; managed full user lifecycle including device provisioning and vendor coordination.

experience.title: Regional IT Administrator
bullets: Sole on-site IT for a campus of ~300 users and 300 workstations, maintaining all classroom, administrative, and testing infrastructure independently, with Meraki network access for emergency response.
